An '''aquamarine crystal''' was a rare kind of [[tasar crystal]] that had the ability to turn an individual [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and to imbue them with a specific [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of attunement. The aquamarine crystal was a pale blue green in color, and had the ability to grant an individual the power of [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometry]], allowing them to read information about the past of an object.<ref name="J15" />
